title: MZ Change the SV Actor position

posts.author: Psychoholic42
posts.body: I'm looking for a way to adjust the X-axis position for specific SV Actors in my game. I have characters that are in the back row, and you can swap out allies in battle. I want it so the back-row characters are a little to the right, no matter what position they are in the formation. I have the SVActorPosition plugin, but that's based on the order of the formation. I need something to put in the character's notes or maybe a script call to get this the way I want it. I know I can use VisuStella's Battle Core to do this, but I don't like that plugin.
